model: M4b-B (gauge timing fixed), input R = radar / g_e

F.type: free knots (shared shape F = A_band G(R), G(5) = 1)
F.why_not: its plug-back failed the VAL length test (4 of 6 cells against the rule's 0.6667)

P.values: plug-back refit; [ ] = 90 % of the form fitted to every bootstrap draw's knots

assumptions.assumption: A(t) = W(t) + L P(R) + c: the antenna and path parts add, the path part is linear in L at matched rain
assumptions.checked: S3.1 / S3b (model-free length test), S5a (V1 length test)

assumptions.assumption: W does not depend on L (antennas are alike at all lengths)
The radar / g_e is the right rain at the path scale (one g_e per event from point gauges, the radar already gauge-adjusted)
assumptions.checked: S4.3 (closes the VAL gap; circular); to check in S7.2-7.3

assumptions.assumption: The gauge timing (tau_f_wet 2.6, tau_f_dry 10.3 min) holds with the radar input
assumptions.checked: S2b (gauge), S3.4 (replicated on VAL), S3b (radar wetting = input smoothing); S6 timing sensitivity

assumptions.assumption: The slow store is fixed (phi 0.72, tau_s 240 min at its bound): not identified, it carries the long tail
One a_link per link, constant over the summer, and the same dynamics in every band
assumptions.checked: S3.3 (both directions); to check in S7.1 / S7.5

assumptions.assumption: The baseline (v2, 24 h dry median before the event) does not follow the drying tail
Dew and other non-rain wetting are not in the model
